steps.do:
Keep only the products that meet every stated need, using the rules.
- Drop any product with an overdraft fee above $0.00 when the customer needs zero (True Blue, World Blue).
- Drop any product whose monthly fee is above the customer's monthly fee budget (Beige $200.00, True Blue $75.00, and World Blue $50.00 when the budget is under $50).
- Drop any product whose minimum balance requirement is above the most the customer can keep (Lime Green $5,000; True Blue $25,000; World Blue $10,000; Beige $250,000).
- Drop a product whose fee-waiver threshold is above that balance ONLY when the customer wants the monthly fee waived or avoided (Lime Green waiver $15,000; True Blue $50,000; World Blue $25,000; Beige $500,000). A waiver threshold is not a minimum balance requirement.
- When the customer wants cashback on general debit card spending (for example supplies, hardware stores, gas), Cobalt Blue's documents give 1.0% cashback on eligible debit card purchases. Hunter Green's 2.0% cashback applies only at certified eco vendors. No other business checking document found mentions cashback, so do not tell the customer any other product gives it.
- Drop Sky Blue when the company is more than 4 years old, or when the customer does not accept the $25.00 fee that starts after the free period.
- Judge the class the customer already holds like every other product: drop it only if it fails a stated need. If it meets every need, ask whether they want another account of that class. No document excludes it.
Example: zero overdraft fees, general debit cashback, ATM rebates and a fee waived on a balance of a few thousand dollars leave Cobalt Blue ($20.00 fee waived at a $2,500 daily balance, 1.0% debit cashback, up to $15 a month in ATM rebates). If no product meets every need, say which need cannot be met.

done_when: The customer is verified and logged, and eligibility is confirmed from the account records. If only the $500 balance failed, one of two things happened. If the customer asked to move funds, the transfer was made from their own OPEN account and eligibility was rechecked. If not, they were told what must be resolved. Every requirement the customer stated has been collected: overdraft, monthly fee budget, ATM rebate, fee-waiver or minimum balance, debit cashback, mobile deposit limit and APY needs, plus company age when Sky Blue is in play. Then one of two things is true. (a) ONE recommendation meeting every stated need has been given. The business checking account the customer chose is open, before any closure, through call_discoverable_agent_tool with open_bank_account_4821. When several accounts qualify, the choice follows the active promotion order. In the 11/01-11/12/2025 overlap, it is the outcome both notices allow, or the customer's choice where the notices conflict. Eco or premium questions were answered without switching away from that recommendation. (b) The customer has been told why the account cannot be opened, or that no account meets every requirement. If the customer also asked for business savings, opening_business_savings_accounts follows.
